prosody_instruction: Speak with mild hesitation and neutral pacing. Slight uncertainty, occasional pauses between phrases.

chunks.text: My brain’s kind of fried after work lately… I’ve been meaning to get back into learning stuff. I keep hearing about this book called Deep Learning, and also this course Business English Speaking sounds like it’d be useful, but I haven’t really sorted anything out.
If that Deep Learning one is available, yeah—sounds good, reserve it under Emily Wang.
And for that Business English Speaking course… sure, go ahead and enroll Xu Jing for it.
